free_text: A biopsy is recommended because the patient has a prior positive biopsy, necessitating re-evaluation, and the evidence shows a rising PSA velocity of 0.34 ng/mL/yr. This is supported by the PI-RADS 3 finding on MRI and the PSA density of 0.13 ng/mL², which, combined with the rising PSA trend, warrants further tissue clarification. The statistical prior suggesting no biopsy was overturned by the clinical evidence pointing toward a need for investigation.
